title: eludite.browser.page_text input
description: Read the rendered text of a tab's page (innerText of the body, or of `root`), as a person sees it, without markup, in pages of at most `max_chars` characters (default 20000). When `next` is in the answer there is more: call again with `cursor: next`. Cheaper than a screenshot for reading content, error messages and tables. Fails with "no tab" when the browser has no tab: call eludite.browser.tab_open first.

root.description: A ref (`e1`, `e2`, ...) from eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.find in the current page generation.

cursor.description: Where to start, in characters: 0 (default) or the `next` of the previous answer.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
